from shop.members import may_borrow, open_db, over_debt_limit


def test_member_without_debt_borrows(tmp_path):
    db = open_db(tmp_path / "m.db")
    assert may_borrow(db, 1, 10) is True


def test_member_with_debt_is_limited(tmp_path):
    db = open_db(tmp_path / "m.db")
    db.execute("insert into debts values(2, 15)")
    assert may_borrow(db, 2, 10) is False
    assert over_debt_limit(db, 2, 10) is True and over_debt_limit(db, 1, 10) is False
